title: The $23 in a Companion Fare Ad Is a Starting Point
caption:
“From $23” is a starting point—not your checkout tax bill.

Already have an Alaska/Atmos cash Companion Fare code? Hypothetically: $420 primary ticket (including taxes) + $99 companion base + $68 companion taxes and fees = $587 for two. Against a comparable $840 tax-inclusive alternative, that saves $253 before card costs and extras. Not a live quote or guaranteed saving.

Use your own code’s base fare and actual checkout taxes. The primary ticket already includes its taxes; the companion taxes field gets only taxes and fees.

Full article: https://practicalrewards.com/blog/the-23-in-a-companion-fare-ad-is-a-starting-point-2c5e9d.html

Calculator: https://practicalrewards.com/calculators/alaska-companion-fare.html

Replace the example taxes before trusting the savings.
